title: A filtered category is cofinally reindexed by a directed set, for colimits and limits at once
statement: Let $\mathcal J$ be a small filtered category. There exist a nonempty directed set $(A,\le)$, objects $x_a$ of $\mathcal J$ ($a\in A$) and morphisms $\varphi_{ab}:x_a\to x_b$ of $\mathcal J$ ($a\le b$) with $\varphi_{aa}=\mathrm{id}$ and $\varphi_{bc}\circ\varphi_{ab}=\varphi_{ac}$ ($a\le b\le c$), such that for every category $\mathcal C$: (1) for every functor $M:\mathcal J\to\mathcal C$ and every colimit cocone $(L,(\iota_x)_{x\in\mathcal J})$ of $M$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $(L,(\iota_{x_a})_{a\in A})$ is a colimit of the directed system $(M(x_a),M(\varphi_{ab}))$ over $A$; (2) for every functor $M:\mathcal J^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ and every limit cone $(S,(\pi_x)_{x\in\mathcal J})$ of $M$ (a colimit in $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}$), $(S,(\pi_{x_a})_{a\in A})$ is a limit of the inverse system $(M(x_a),M(\varphi_{ab}))$ over $A$. The same $A$, $x_a$, $\varphi_{ab}$ serve for all $\mathcal C$ and $M$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0032 (lemma-directed-category-system), categories.tex line 2710, clauses (1) and (2)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-category-exists-directed-final] to obtain a nonempty directed set A and a functor F:A\to\mathcal J satisfying the finality conditions (1) and (2) of that statement. Write x_a=F(a) and let \varphi_{ab}:x_a\to x_b be the image under F of the unique morphism a\to b of A when a\le b. Functoriality gives \varphi_{aa}=\mathrm{id} and \varphi_{bc}\circ\varphi_{ab}=\varphi_{ac}, and A, x_a, \varphi_{ab} do not depend on any target category or diagram.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0032 (lemma-directed-category-system), categories.tex line 2710, construction of the directed system

proof.text: Put H=F^{\mathrm{op}}:A^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal J^{\mathrm{op}}. The category A^{\mathrm{op}} is cofiltered since A is a nonempty directed set. H satisfies hypotheses (i) and (ii) of clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-initial-functor-cofiltered-criterion]: a morphism H(a)\to y in \mathcal J^{\mathrm{op}} is a morphism y\to F(a) in \mathcal J, so (i) is condition (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-category-exists-directed-final]. For (ii), let s,s':y\to F(a) in \mathcal J. Condition (2) of that statement gives a sequence a=a_0\ge a_1\le a_2\ge\cdots\le a_{2n}=a and b_i:y\to F(a_i) with b_0=s, b_{2n}=s' and F(a_{2k+1}\to a_{2k})\circ b_{2k+1}=b_{2k}, F(a_{2k+1}\to a_{2k+2})\circ b_{2k+1}=b_{2k+2}. Choose c\in A with c\ge a_i for all i (A is directed and the sequence is finite). By functoriality F(a_i\to c)\circ b_i is the same morphism for all i, so F(a\to c)\circ s=F(a\to c)\circ s'; in \mathcal J^{\mathrm{op}} this is s\circ H(t)=s'\circ H(t) for the morphism t:c\to a of A^{\mathrm{op}}. Now take \mathcal B=\mathcal J^{\mathrm{op}}, so \mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}=\mathcal J and H^{\mathrm{op}}=F. For a category \mathcal C, a functor M:\mathcal J\to\mathcal C and a colimit cocone (L,(\iota_x)_x) of M, the cited statement says that M\circ F has a colimit and that the canonical map \varinjlim_A M\circ F\to L induced by the \iota_{x_a} is an isomorphism; hence (L,(\iota_{x_a})_a) is a colimit of the directed system (M(x_a),M(\varphi_{ab})). This is clause (1).

source.place: Lemma Tag 0032 (lemma-directed-category-system), clause (1), via Lemma Tag 04E7 (lemma-cofinal)

proof.text: Let H=F^{\mathrm{op}}:A^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal J^{\mathrm{op}} as in step 2. H is initial in the sense of conditions (1) and (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-initial-functor-limit]: (1) is condition (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-category-exists-directed-final] read in \mathcal J^{\mathrm{op}}. For (2), given b:y\to F(a), b':y\to F(a') in \mathcal J, take the sequence a=a_0\ge a_1\le\cdots\le a_{2n}=a' and the b_i of condition (2) of that statement and insert identities at both ends, c_0=c_1=a_0, c_{j+1}=a_j (1\le j\le 2n), c_{2n+2}=a_{2n}, with the corresponding morphisms from y; then c_0\le c_1\ge c_2\le c_3\ge\cdots\ge c_{2n+2} in A, i.e. c_0\leftarrow c_1\rightarrow c_2\leftarrow\cdots\rightarrow c_{2n+2} in A^{\mathrm{op}}, and the compatibilities of (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-initial-functor-limit] are, read in \mathcal J, those of the given sequence (and trivial at the identities). For a category \mathcal C, a functor M:\mathcal J^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C and a limit cone (S,(\pi_x)_x) of M, clause (a) of [lem-weil-pbc-initial-functor-limit] says that the restricted cone (S,(\pi_{x_a})_a) is a limit of M\circ H, which is the inverse system (M(x_a),M(\varphi_{ab})) over A. This proves clause (2) with the same A, x_a, \varphi_{ab}.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0032 (lemma-directed-category-system), clause (2), via Lemma Tag 002R (lemma-initial)

lean.statement: theorem exists_directed_reindexing (J : Type w) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] : ∃ (A : Type w) (_ : Preorder A) (_ : IsDirected A (· ≤ ·)) (_ : Nonempty A) (F : A ⥤ J), ∀ (C : Type u) (_ : Category.{v} C), (∀ (M : J ⥤ C) (c : Cocone M), IsColimit c → Nonempty (IsColimit (c.whisker F))) ∧ (∀ (M : Jᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (c : Cone M), IsLimit c → Nonempty (IsLimit (c.whisker F.op)))
